title: NO BACKPACK LINE AT EXTRACTION
why: His note of 2026-10-12: HEAVY BACKPACK, why does it say that when extracting, we got rid of different backpack sizes a long time ago. Calling extraction said a third line after the siege, LIGHT, LOADED or HEAVY BACKPACK with They heard that, Expect company or Fewer will come under it. It was read off how much the haul is worth, not a pack size, and there is only one grid backpack, so it read as nonsense. The line is gone, in solo and on a linked window. The siege still grows with the value of what you carry, it just does not say so. No other backpack weight wording was left anywhere in the game.
now: Calling extraction no longer says LIGHT, LOADED or HEAVY BACKPACK.
